kind: production browser regression; includes genuine snapshot continuations, not a human/full mission playtest

tests.title: production prefix loads assets; real click captures mouse; shooting, reload and pause work
real keyboard movement reaches and stores checkpoint; restart and page reload restore it
corrupt checkpoint is explained and a new mission remains available
missing models are reported and procedural fallback keeps the area playable
M01 loads the nine bridge LODs; real controls operate bolt, clip, sight, aiming, pause and CP-A
licensed character rigs and first-person hands follow real weapon state, preserve pause and use the light preset
an optional character download failure preserves playable procedural actors without blocking bridge validation
real keyboard movement traverses the approaches and E delivers the message at the rail bridge
adjustment salvo at the gates restores its actual origin and follows mouse look
adjustment salvo behind the truss restores its actual origin and follows mouse look
demolition inside the road truss shows the actual bearing while mouse look remains free
a genuine CP-D reload keeps east destruction and casualties, including restart and page reload
the actual outro state can be skipped through the UI into the enabled historical debrief
German fire on the repair is drawn from the Lisewo gates and the HUD status line is the simulation state
the real roll-call snapshot renders seated actors and keeps their pose after page reload
a real withdrawal continuation loses men only to rounds from the spans, keeps the twelve-survivor floor and shows the count in the HUD
a failed M01 bridge load prevents an invisible bridge; the French sandbox remains selectable
textured atmosphere survives checkpoint restart without duplicating resources; low quality reduces vegetation
